title: Silverpeak survey district map, 1956
credit: New Zealand Railways Corporation, District Engineer’s Office, Dunedin; Archives New Zealand, ref. DABB D101 409/23 (R6619107); via Wikimedia Commons.
altText: 1956 NZMS 13 cadastral survey-district map sheet for Silverpeak, Otago, with parcel boundaries and printed labels.
caption: NZMS 13 cadastral survey-district sheet 122, Silverpeak, Otago, third edition, 1956.
context: This printed cadastral survey-district sheet is an example of the paper record maps used before a national digital cadastral database. Its lines and labels served an administrative map purpose; the image should not be read as a modern GIS screen or as proof that every drawn boundary had survey-grade coordinates.
